第1266章 为师纵是身死（第1页）
苏清欢指尖捏的发白，玉颜之上满是忧虑，可她却什么也没说。
若不能驯服法则，就将被其奴役，她当年也是这般走过来的。
毕竟是四大法则之一的时空法则，哪怕只有其中的‘时间’，依旧恐怖如斯。
纵然此刻心如刀绞，苏清欢依然强压对徒儿的担心，无声呢喃着。
同时，苏清欢在心底向玉女观的历代老祖们祈求，祈求她们能够保佑叶凡。
叶凡痛苦嘶吼，声音在密室中不断回荡，如同刀子般在苏清欢心尖儿来回剜割。
她这个做师父的，不忍再看，咬着唇别过头闭上眼。
因为她怕叶凡撑不住，更怕不能及时救下徒儿。
如此过了不知多久，久到让苏清欢感觉，仿佛过去了几千年。
叶凡声音嘶哑的笑了起来：“不过是区区时间法则而已，在老子叶凡面前，也得乖乖听话！”
苏清欢睁开眼，就看到叶凡口鼻流血，满头白发。
最重要的是，叶凡仿若刚从棺材里爬出来似的，浑身弥漫着浓烈死气，全身血肉几近于无，就剩些许皮肤贴着骨骼。
瞧见傻师父望来，已是暮年模样的叶凡，扯了扯嘴角，勉强挤出一个虚弱笑容：“师父，徒儿驯服时间法则了。”
苏清欢快速上前，将气若游丝的叶凡抱在怀里。
“师父，我没事儿，我……我真没事儿。”
叶凡一边说，一边缓缓闭上了眼睛。
不能睡，睁开眼……快，快睁开眼！”

苏清欢顿时急了，不断将神念探入储物戒指里，可……神念石沉大海，没有丝毫回应。
叶凡所携带的黑色古玉，亦是无法进入！
苏清欢一颗心坠入谷底，叶凡如今状态已是油尽灯枯，必须尽快补充寿元，否则必将身死道陨。
延寿的丹药也好，灵植也好，都在储物戒指里，根本取不出来。
苏清欢眼睛一亮，连忙寻到残破香炉。
只是下一秒，苏清欢眸中的光亮瞬间黯淡。
因为香炉中的香灰，早已被消耗的干干净净，显然是叶凡之前全部使用掉了。
在时间法则的挣扎下，欠寿诸多的叶凡，恐怕早已身死。
苏清欢不由慌了神，哪怕贝齿咬破红唇，丝丝鲜血溢出，也没有察觉到一丝疼痛。
感受着怀中生命气息在快速流逝的叶凡，苏清欢忽然想起，她体内还有一丝丝灵蕴。
仅仅思考几个呼吸，苏清欢便深吸一口气，神色陡然凝重起来，似是下定了什么决心。
苏清欢呢喃自语道：“无玄，若你能逃过此劫，为师纵是身死……”

Chapter 1266 Even if you die as a teacher (page 1)
Su Qinghuan's fingertips turned white, and her beautiful face was full of worry, but she didn't say anything.
If you can't tame the law, you will be enslaved by it. This is how she went through it back then.
After all, it is the law of space and time, one of the four laws. Even if there is only 'time' in it, it is still terrifying.
Even though her heart was as sharp as a knife at this moment, Su Qinghuan still suppressed her worries about her disciple and murmured silently.
At the same time, Su Qinghuan prayed to the ancestors of the Jade Girl Temple from the bottom of her heart, praying that they could protect Ye Fan.
Ye Fan screamed in pain, his voice echoing in the secret room, cutting back and forth at the tip of Su Qinghuan's heart like a knife.
As a master, she couldn't bear to look at it anymore, so she bit her lip and turned her head away and closed her eyes.
Because she was afraid that Ye Fan wouldn't be able to hold on, and she was even more afraid that she wouldn't be able to save her disciple in time.
An unknown amount of time passed like this, so long that Su Qinghuan felt as if thousands of years had passed.
Ye Fan laughed hoarsely: "It's just a mere rule of time. You have to be obedient in front of me, Ye Fan!"
Su Qinghuan opened her eyes and saw Mark's mouth and nose bleeding, and his head full of white hair.
The most important thing is that Ye Fan seems to have just crawled out of the coffin. His whole body is filled with strong death energy, and there is almost no flesh and blood in his body, leaving only a little skin sticking to the bones.
Seeing the silly master looking at him, Ye Fan, who was already in his twilight years, twitched his lips and forced a weak smile: "Master, my disciple has tamed the law of time."
Su Qinghuan quickly stepped forward and held the angry Ye Fan in her arms.
"Master, I'm fine, I...I'm really fine."
Ye Fan said while slowly closing his eyes.
Can't sleep, open your eyes... Hurry, open your eyes! "
Su Qinghuan suddenly became anxious and kept putting her spiritual thoughts into the storage ring, but... her spiritual thoughts fell into the sea without any response.
The black ancient jade carried by Ye Fan is also inaccessible!
Su Qinghuan's heart fell to the bottom. Ye Fan was now in a state of exhaustion and had to replenish his life span as soon as possible, otherwise he would die.
Whether it is life-extending elixirs or spiritual plants, they are all in the storage ring and cannot be taken out at all.
Su Qinghuan's eyes lit up and she quickly found the broken incense burner.
Just the next second, the light in Su Qinghuan's eyes dimmed instantly.
Because the incense ashes in the incense burner had been completely consumed, obviously Mark had used them all before.
Under the struggle of the law of time, Ye Fan, who has a long life expectancy, may have died long ago.
Su Qinghuan couldn't help but panic. Even though her teeth bit her red lip and a trace of blood spilled out, she didn't notice any pain.
Feeling the rapid passage of life in Ye Fan's arms, Su Qinghuan suddenly remembered that there was still a trace of spiritual energy in her body.
After just thinking for a few breaths, Su Qinghuan took a deep breath, and her expression suddenly became serious, as if she had made up her mind.
Su Qinghuan murmured to himself: "Wuxuan, if you can escape this disaster, you will die as a teacher..."
